what: Pressing ☰ on the vertical side-menu card lays an overlay over the screen, and the white panel hidden behind the card at the same width unfolds to the right (496px) in 0.3s. Once fully open, the subheading turns on in 0.3s and list rows enter from 50px left and transparent, 0.2s each at 0.05s intervals (the first row 0.025s ahead). Pressing another ☰ keeps the panel as is, withdraws the old rows the same way, and sets up the new rows 0.175s later. The ☰ inside the panel unfolds a gray three-tier panel (750px) further in the same order. On overlay click or Esc, the rows vanish in 0.2s and then the panel folds

options.width: Width in px at which the 2-column panel unfolds, default 496
options.row: Length of one line’s entrance, default .2
options.from: Distance in px the line enters from along x, default -50
options.swap: On switching, wait for the old line to clear before the new line, default .175
options.fade: Length for the line to vanish on close, default .2
options.[data-fx-part=open] data-key: Button that opens column 2 — when open it gets is-on (☰ → arrow shape is in the consuming CSS)
options.[data-fx-part=open3] data-key: Button that opens a 3rd column inside a 2-column layout
options.[data-fx-part=panel] · [data-fx-part=pan: Unfolding panel (stacked at the same size as the card)
options.[data-fx-part=list] data-key: List group inside the panel — the li inside are rows, [data-fx-part=head] is the subheading
options.--fx-from-left · --fx-from-left3 · --fx-: List slot (via style) — default card width 240, then 30px, top 45px, width 196
